notes.note: Reviewed only the install-smoke workflow dependency after the bounded localhost fixture readiness change. Fixture artifacts, signed manifest and test key remain disposable localhost inputs behind explicit insecure-test overrides; production installer parsing, signatures, archive verification, publication gates, cask behavior and portable formats are unchanged. Python fixture output is now unbuffered; the owning install step requires each recorded process to stay alive and answer its fixture URL before invoking the installer. A real Linux localhost server reached readiness and a settled server refused with a named process diagnosis. This does not establish macOS runner startup, native application launch, public distribution or the cause of the prior 394 localhost refusal. All unrelated source histories and claims remain outside this review.
